ownRead.title: Life and evolution
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O7 — Life and evolution.** H27 makes success explicit as survival plus favourable environmental change, spread and possible joining (01 §10.1). These are separate observables, not a universal ranking or a claim that life intends domination. Chemical cooperative organization and nonliving pattern duplication supply informative analogies. Biological heredity, evolutionary dynamics and planetary environmental change are not reduced to one measured resonant mechanism here. The universal relation is a hypothesis about organizational form, not an assertion that all systems are living or intentional.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

Separate chemical persistence, multiplication and cooperation from heredity and open-ended biological evolution. The selected catalytic-network and driven granular cases report particular mechanisms; they do not establish the transition between all these roles. A contribution could investigate one missing transition in a specified chemical model or experiment.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
